title: The Love of God
speaker: Guest Speaker
description:
The Love of God | God's unfailing love, grace for sinners, repentance, and salvation in Christ - 1 John 4:10

God's love is deeper than we can measure and stronger than we can exhaust. In 1 John 4:10, we see that love does not begin with us reaching for God, but with God loving us first and sending His Son to be the sacrifice for our sins. His love is not earned by our goodness, increased by our strength, or canceled by our weakness. He loves because that is who He is.

From Deuteronomy 7, we are reminded that God set His love on His people by His own gracious choice. That truth humbles us and comforts us at the same time. Even when others fail us, abandon us, or misunderstand us, the Lord remains faithful. Yet His love is never permission to stay in sin. He loves us as we are, but He loves us too much to leave us there.

In Jesus, we see how far that love goes. He humbled Himself, came near to us, and gave Himself at the cross so we would not be separated from God forever. So we are called to answer His love with repentance, gratitude, and obedience, trusting that the hard way of sin can give way to the restoring mercy of God.
